description: Import multiple credit cards in one call. Accepts natural language names (fuzzy matched against catalog) or exact card_template_ids. Returns per-card results: created, already_exists, ambiguous (with candidates), or failed. IMPORTANT: Use dry_run=true for first-time imports to confirm matches before committing. Household member profiles (owner names) must exist before import — create them first if needed. CreditSync stores card product names and metadata only; full card numbers are never stored or transmitted.

card_template_id.description: Exact catalog template ID — bypasses fuzzy matching.

counts_toward_524.description: Override 5/24 counting. Defaults: true for personal, false for business.

fee_month.description: Month annual fee posts (1-12). Inferred from open date if omitted.

is_business.description: Business card? Defaults to false. Business cards excluded from 5/24.

name.description: Card name for fuzzy matching (e.g., 'Amex Platinum', 'Chase Sapphire Reserve'). Required unless card_template_id is provided.

nickname.description: Last 4 digits or distinguishing label for duplicate cards.

original_open_date.description: Account open date (YYYY-MM-DD). Used for 5/24 and fee month inference.

owner.description: Cardholder profile name (must exist in household).

welcome_offer.description: Attach a welcome offer at creation time.

dry_run.description: If true, validate and match but don't create. Returns what WOULD happen.

skip_duplicates.description: If true (default), skip existing cards. If false, return error for duplicates.

name: bulk_import_cards
